#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct copy_request_t {
    pub job_id: crate::common_types::job_id_t,
    pub job_update: crate::transfer_types::job_update_t,
    pub source_instance: crate::transfer_types::instance_info_t,
}

pub mod blob_service {
    pub const PROGRAM: u32 = 200001;

    pub mod blob_service_v1 {
        pub const VERSION: u32 = 1;
        pub const BLOB_NULL: u32 = 0;
        pub const BLOB_COPY: u32 = 1;
    }

}
